name: Deathbane Touch
body:
Your touch can infect and drain vitality from undead.

Prerequisite: Obitu.

Benefit: Once per day, whenever you make a successful touch attack against an undead foe, you may regain 1d8 hit points, and the undead must immediately make a saving throw versus the vivification virus with a DC equal to 13 + your character level . If the target fails the saving throw, he is immediately afflicted with the vivification virus. If the undead is already infected, it is instead affected by the effect of the disease.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
